title: Launch of DTS AutoStage Broadcaster Portal Premium Tier Sets New Radio Intelligence and Measurement Standard
summary: New features enable premium subscribers to access unprecedented daypart-level station ranking detail, reported in near real-time as DTS AutoStage surpasses 16 million vehicles globally Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER) today announced the launch of DTS AutoStage Broadcaster Portal Premium , a new standard in radio intelligence that advances the company’s existing broadcaster portal to provide radio stations with the most comprehensive and timely listening analytics available on the market. The new premium tier features go live on April 16 and will be demonstrated in Xperi’s booth (#C2259) at the NAB Show Las Vegas, April 18-22.
